 15:04   ,  October 23, 2026 French Championship: Matchweek 8 to kick off
 The 8th round of the French football championship will kick off on October 23 with a match between Brest and Nice. 
 The league leaders are Lyon, PSG, Paris, Lille, and Monaco, each with 14 points.
